remarks: Elegant, sun-drenched and sophisticated, this timeless country estate, built by Alex Kaali-Nagy and decorated by Lynn Morgan, offers the ultimate in superior quality construction, luxurious amenities, exceptional millwork, refined architectural details, built-ins galore and a fabulous versatile floor plan for easy living and gracious entertaining. With four fully finished floors, highlights include 7 large ensuite bedrooms with walk-in closets,10 foot ceilings,7 fireplaces, front to back grand entrance hall, elevator, full house generator, slate roof, expansive covered rear porch, bluestone terraces, fabulous chef's eat-in kitchen opening into the family room, handsome library and adjacent home office, wet bar, spectacular second floor playroom, exercise room and so much more. The serene private 4 acre property on coveted West Rd. is equally impressive. The deep play yard is surrounded by majestic trees, beautiful professional landscaping and glorious gardens. There is a fabulous new Gunite heated pool by Shoreline with retractable cover, a charming custom fitted gazebo and an amazing newly restored circa 1790 barn with loft and several garage spaces. In addition, there is courtyard parking for guests and a separate service entrance for convenience. Make this your forever home to love and cherish and build special memories with family and friends. Welcome to 584 West Rd.!
